name: Roadmap
job: Features ranked by who asked, with the spec drafted from what they said
intro: Roadmap lists every feature with the people who asked for it: how many, at which companies, who calls it a blocker and the deals behind them. Put features in Now, Next or Later, follow them in Tasks, and draft a spec whose every line cites what someone said.
does: Features ranked by people, companies, blockers, open or won deals: sort by any column. There is no score to tune.
Now, Next and Later as a board, with progress from each item's Tasks project and a flag when work stops moving.
A one-page spec drafted from the quotes, every line marked with the quotes behind it; lines you edit are kept.
setup: Once for the whole Lemma: your product's name, who leads the roadmap, the currency, and when a Now item counts as stale.
Or look around with sample features: a made-up product and what fourteen made-up companies asked for.
Turn on the outside page when you want one: only the items you mark public, under their public titles.
